    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        E = state_variables[0, :]
        I = state_variables[1, :]
        W_e = state_variables[2, :]
        W_i = state_variables[3, :]
        ou_drift = state_variables[4, :]

        C_m = self.C_m
        DTvN0 = self.DTvN0
        DmuV0 = self.DmuV0
        DsV0 = self.DsV0
        E_L_e = self.E_L_e
        E_L_i = self.E_L_i
        E_e = self.E_e
        E_i = self.E_i
        K_ext_e = self.K_ext_e
        K_ext_i = self.K_ext_i
        N_tot = self.N_tot
        P0_e = self.P0_e
        P0_i = self.P0_i
        P1_e = self.P1_e
        P1_i = self.P1_i
        P2_e = self.P2_e
        P2_i = self.P2_i
        P3_e = self.P3_e
        P3_i = self.P3_i
        P4_e = self.P4_e
        P4_i = self.P4_i
        P5_e = self.P5_e
        P5_i = self.P5_i
        P6_e = self.P6_e
        P6_i = self.P6_i
        P7_e = self.P7_e
        P7_i = self.P7_i
        P8_e = self.P8_e
        P8_i = self.P8_i
        P9_e = self.P9_e
        P9_i = self.P9_i
        Q_e = self.Q_e
        Q_i = self.Q_i
        S_i = self.S_i
        T = self.T
        TvN0 = self.TvN0
        a_e = self.a_e
        a_i = self.a_i
        b_e = self.b_e
        b_i = self.b_i
        external_input_ex_ex = self.external_input_ex_ex
        external_input_ex_in = self.external_input_ex_in
        external_input_in_ex = self.external_input_in_ex
        external_input_in_in = self.external_input_in_in
        g_L = self.g_L
        g = self.g
        muV0 = self.muV0
        p_connect_e = self.p_connect_e
        p_connect_i = self.p_connect_i
        sV0 = self.sV0
        tau_OU = self.tau_OU
        tau_e = self.tau_e
        tau_i = self.tau_i
        tau_w_e = self.tau_w_e
        tau_w_i = self.tau_w_i
        weight_noise = self.weight_noise

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)
        c_glob = coupling[0, :]

        # Derived Variables
        self.lc_E = lc_E = E * local_coupling
        self.lc_I = lc_I = I * local_coupling
        self.Fe_ext = Fe_ext = np.where(
            np.less(K_ext_e * (c_glob + lc_E + ou_drift * weight_noise), 0),
            0,
            c_glob + lc_E + ou_drift * weight_noise,
        )
        self.Fi_ext = Fi_ext = lc_I
        self.fe_e = fe_e = K_ext_e * (
            Fe_ext + external_input_ex_ex
        ) + N_tot * p_connect_e * (1 / 1000000 + E) * (1.0 - g)
        self.fe_i = fe_i = K_ext_e * (
            Fe_ext + external_input_in_ex
        ) + N_tot * p_connect_e * (1 / 1000000 + E) * (1.0 - g)
        self.fi_e = fi_e = K_ext_i * (
            Fi_ext + external_input_ex_in
        ) + N_tot * g * p_connect_i * (1 / 1000000 + I)
        self.fi_i = fi_i = K_ext_i * (
            Fi_ext + external_input_in_in
        ) + N_tot * g * p_connect_i * (1 / 1000000 + I)
        self.mu_Ge_e = mu_Ge_e = Q_e * fe_e * tau_e
        self.mu_Ge_i = mu_Ge_i = Q_e * fe_i * tau_e
        self.mu_Gi_e = mu_Gi_e = Q_i * fi_e * tau_i
        self.mu_Gi_i = mu_Gi_i = Q_i * fi_i * tau_i
        self.mu_G_e = mu_G_e = g_L + mu_Ge_e + mu_Gi_e
        self.mu_G_i = mu_G_i = g_L + mu_Ge_i + mu_Gi_i
        self.T_m_e = T_m_e = C_m / mu_G_e
        self.T_m_i = T_m_i = C_m / mu_G_i
        self.mu_V_e = mu_V_e = (
            -W_e + E_L_e * g_L + E_e * mu_Ge_e + E_i * mu_Gi_e
        ) / mu_G_e
        self.mu_V_i = mu_V_i = (
            -W_i + E_L_i * g_L + E_e * mu_Ge_i + E_i * mu_Gi_i
        ) / mu_G_i
        self.U_e_e = U_e_e = Q_e * (E_e - mu_V_e) / mu_G_e
        self.U_e_i = U_e_i = Q_e * (E_e - mu_V_i) / mu_G_i
        self.U_i_e = U_i_e = Q_i * (E_i - mu_V_e) / mu_G_e
        self.U_i_i = U_i_i = Q_i * (E_i - mu_V_i) / mu_G_i
        self.V_e = V_e = (mu_V_e - muV0) / DmuV0
        self.V_i = V_i = (mu_V_i - muV0) / DmuV0
        self.T_V_e = T_V_e = (
            fe_e * U_e_e**2 * tau_e**2 + fi_e * U_i_e**2 * tau_i**2
        ) / (
            fe_e * U_e_e**2 * tau_e**2 / (T_m_e + tau_e)
            + fi_e * U_i_e**2 * tau_i**2 / (T_m_e + tau_i)
        )
        self.T_V_i = T_V_i = (
            fe_i * U_e_i**2 * tau_e**2 + fi_i * U_i_i**2 * tau_i**2
        ) / (
            fe_i * U_e_i**2 * tau_e**2 / (T_m_i + tau_e)
            + fi_i * U_i_i**2 * tau_i**2 / (T_m_i + tau_i)
        )
        self.sigma_V_e = sigma_V_e = np.sqrt(
            fe_e * U_e_e**2 * tau_e**2 / (2.0 * T_m_e + 2.0 * tau_e)
            + fi_e * U_i_e**2 * tau_i**2 / (2.0 * T_m_e + 2.0 * tau_i)
        )
        self.sigma_V_i = sigma_V_i = np.sqrt(
            fe_i * U_e_i**2 * tau_e**2 / (2.0 * T_m_i + 2.0 * tau_e)
            + fi_i * U_i_i**2 * tau_i**2 / (2.0 * T_m_i + 2.0 * tau_i)
        )
        self.S_e = S_e = (sigma_V_e - sV0) / DsV0
        self.S_i = S_i = (sigma_V_i - sV0) / DsV0
        self.T_e = T_e = (-TvN0 + T_V_e * g_L / C_m) / DTvN0
        self.T_i = T_i = (-TvN0 + T_V_i * g_L / C_m) / DTvN0
        self.V_thre_e = V_thre_e = (
            1000.0 * P0_e
            + 1000.0 * P1_e * V_e
            + 1000.0 * P2_e * S_e
            + 1000.0 * P3_e * T_e
            + 1000.0 * P4_e * V_e**2
            + 1000.0 * P5_e * S_e**2
            + 1000.0 * P6_e * T_e**2
            + 1000.0 * P7_e * S_e * V_e
            + 1000.0 * P8_e * T_e * V_e
            + 1000.0 * P9_e * S_e * T_e
        )
        self.V_thre_i = V_thre_i = (
            1000.0 * P0_i
            + 1000.0 * P1_i * V_i
            + 1000.0 * P2_i * S_i
            + 1000.0 * P3_i * T_i
            + 1000.0 * P4_i * V_i**2
            + 1000.0 * P5_i * S_i**2
            + 1000.0 * P6_i * T_i**2
            + 1000.0 * P7_i * S_i * V_i
            + 1000.0 * P8_i * T_i * V_i
            + 1000.0 * P9_i * S_i * T_i
        )
        self.f_out_e = f_out_e = (
            (1 / 2)
            * scipy.special.erfc((1 / 2) * np.sqrt(2) * (V_thre_e - mu_V_e) / sigma_V_e)
            / T_V_e
        )
        self.f_out_i = f_out_i = (
            (1 / 2)
            * scipy.special.erfc((1 / 2) * np.sqrt(2) * (V_thre_i - mu_V_i) / sigma_V_i)
            / T_V_i
        )

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray((f_out_e - E) / T),  # E
            np.asarray((f_out_i - I) / T),  # I
            np.asarray(
                E * b_e - W_e / tau_w_e + a_e * (mu_V_e - E_L_e) / tau_w_e
            ),  # W_e
            np.asarray(
                I * b_i - W_i / tau_w_i + a_i * (mu_V_i - E_L_i) / tau_w_i
            ),  # W_i
            np.asarray(-ou_drift / tau_OU),  # ou_drift
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
